mostWorthwhile.text: Reusing iron in new red blood cells was most worthwhile: it connected recycling old cells to making their oxygen-carrying protein.

leastWorthwhile.text: The skin-growth combination was clear but fairly predictable from the picture, so it offered less to figure out.

surprise.text: The recovered iron travelled in blood attached to proteins, rather than appearing as pieces of metal.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; the pictures and goals made both pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see another connection between body systems, though these pairings were straightforward and did not create a strong hook.
